findings: 1.6.1 selects `landmark_genes` while loading the CSVs and fits one `StandardScaler` on the unique training cell lines of the drug, then runs `Pipeline(mrmr, knn)`. v2 selects the list in the `landmarkGenes` featurizer (standardize=false, arcsinh) and runs `Pipeline(StandardScaler, MRMRSelector, NeighborCappedKNN)` per drug, so the scaler is fitted on the training pairs of the drug, the same rows (one pair per sample and drug).

v2 holds features as float32 end to end, 1.6.1 as float64. The end-to-end feature, distance and prediction steps therefore agree to float32 precision (class forward), not exactly; the mRMR selection and the neighbour sets are compared exactly. The `identical` steps feed both estimators the same float64 matrix and are exact.
The 1.6.1 default (first grid point) is n_neighbors=3, v2's `SingleDrugKNN` preset declares the same default and extends the tunable range to 20 (1.6.1 grid: 3, 5, 10, 20).
v2 clamps `n_neighbors` inside the estimator when it is fitted (`NeighborCappedKNN`); 1.6.1 clamps in `train` through `set_params`. Both give `min(n_neighbors, n_rows)`.
